mediation-vector.name: selection-prunes-overreach
mediation-vector.description: A selection is also a membership statement: core's facts edge declares junk:1, but the site's resolution pruned it (e.g. via the seed's depMgmt exclusions, scope overrides, or platform filtering), so junk is absent from the selection. The on-selection walk must not follow edges outside the selection domain -- junk stays out, exactly as jgo resolved. Found on real data: the fiji index's identity self-check over-reached into xalan/eventbus subgraphs jgo had pruned.
